exposure: Clear fluid intake one hour prior to anesthesia
Clear fluid intake one hour prior to induction of anesthesia
taking clear fluid an hour prior to the induction of anesthesia
outcome: Regurgitation during general anesthesia for cesarean section
cohort: 411 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section
finding: There was no evidence to suggest that taking clear fluids about 1 hour before cesarean section increases the risk of regurgitation.
